tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground under the header, hero and sections. Ink and body text read on it at 15.0:1 and 10.7:1 in light, 15.0:1 and 8.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card, panel and plate fill (app cards). Ink and body text on it hold 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px rules between sections, the header and footer borders and card borders. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control (use border-control).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The film-frame corner marks on app cards. Decorative: never carries meaning or text. The one non-palette value in the system, dark theme only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark, labels, the primary button fill and the focus ring. Text on paper and surface at 15.0:1 and 14.0:1 in light, 15.0:1 and 13.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text, ledes, card descriptions and footer text on paper and surface. 10.7:1 on paper and 10.0:1 on surface in light; 8.8:1 and 7.6:1 in dark. Never set body copy in ink.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and the hollow ring of a Planned status dot. 3.3:1 on paper and 3.1:1 on surface in light, 4.5:1 and 3.9:1 in dark. Never used for text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: link underlines, the active-nav underline, filled status dots and the hover fill of the primary button. Never text. In light it is 1.9:1 on paper, so it never carries meaning alone: a status dot always sits beside its word.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button). 15.0:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (primary button on hover). 7.7:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text, always with a message. 6.5:1 on paper in light, 6.9:1 in dark. Not part of the Grains palette: the system's single added hue.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 4px offset, on every interactive element. Same value as ink so it holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Palette. Darkest value. Light-theme ink and primary button, dark-theme page. Source of paper (dark) and ink (light).

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Palette. Warm off-white, the light-theme page and the dark-theme ink. Never replace it with pure white.

tokens.name: dark-ink
tokens.usage: Palette. Light-theme body text. Dense but not dead.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Palette. Dark-theme body text and the light-theme frame. Never text on ivory (it fails contrast).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Palette. Control borders and unselected dots. Never text on ivory.

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Palette. Light-theme surface. Gives cards depth without a new hue.

tokens.name: grain-line
tokens.usage: Palette. Light-theme rules and borders.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Palette. The single accent. Use sparingly and never as text.

tokens.name: dark-surface
tokens.usage: Palette. Dark-theme surface.

tokens.name: dark-line
tokens.usage: Palette. Dark-theme rules and borders.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Small AI apps that each do one job.
styles.usage: The home page headline, once per page. Ink on paper. 56px on a phone: scale with clamp(56px, 8vw, 96px).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The title of an inner page. Ink on paper. 48px on a phone: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. Ink on paper. 30px on a phone: clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 36px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and feature names. Ink on paper or surface.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header. The only use of Semibold.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Turtlebox builds AI apps that run in your browser.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline. Body on paper, 30em wide at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An app does one thing and says what that is before you start.
styles.usage: Running text. Body on paper, 34em wide at most, ragged right.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Estimate how big a product opportunity is from a few inputs.
styles.usage: Card descriptions and feature text. Body on paper or surface.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: Footer, fine print and metadata. Body on paper.

styles.name: field
styles.usage: Text typed into inputs. Ink on paper.

styles.name: message
styles.sample: That address does not look right.
styles.usage: Form status and error messages. Ink or danger on surface.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Navigation, form labels and status words. Set in uppercase. Body or ink.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and text links. Set in uppercase. Medium weight.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, between a title and its status, and between a card title and its text.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Page gutter, header padding, field padding and the gap between a card's blocks.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Heading to body, and the horizontal padding of a small button.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links, between cards and between a lede and its call to action; side padding of a button.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gap before a grid or call-to-action row, card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop and the top of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, cards and every other box. Corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

tokens.name: radius-app-icon
tokens.usage: The rounded app icon in assets/Icons. App stores apply their own mask to the square versions.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover and color transitions.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Fade-ins and photograph-paced reveals.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition. No springs, no bounce.
